notes.title: Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense Update 1.0.5 History
notes.notes:
Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense Update 1.0.5 History

[h2]1. Add zodiac upgrade[/h2]
A new upgrade has appeared in the Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense!
Zodiac upgrade is an upgrade that gives certain 'tier' units a variety of beneficial effects, including attack speed, critical probability, and critical damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/50d6fbb3479a0c928cdb1110481f13ac9c118146.gif[/img]
You observe stars in the night sky and find (fictional)zodiac. If you get rid of the boss monsters on each stage, you'll find another new zodiac.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/c59281b4b49ba93ffbd55dc1ad034d85ae56fa22.gif[/img]
To observe the zodiac in detail, the telescope is scaled, and the result determines the unit rating and the number of upgrades to be granted.

In short, [b] Another new Gacha has appeared![/b]
Meet stronger units with this upgrade!


[h2]2. Change the unit Gacha probability[/h2]
The unit has changed the probability. The reasons are as follows.
The way in which units are determined in the Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense, you get 10 cards and you get the highest grade of units. The higher the unit's rating (Leg, UR, SSR, …) the more likely the unit's Gacha probability is to actually get a unit of that grade, but the lower the UC unit's Gacha probability and the UC class's probability were too different.

For example, if 1 card is an R card and 9 cards are UC cards, the result is that you get a unit of an R card, which means that even if UC has appeared many times, it is very likely that the unit you actually get is not UC rated. In fact, calculations showed that the probability of obtaining a UC-class unit was only 7-8%.
Therefore, I adjusted the appearance probability according to the value of the [b] unit. [/b]
This is necessary and you can check the reason in number 3.

[h2]3. Monster Hp Change[/h2]
The monster's hp is determined based on the unit's expected value damage considering the probability. Of course, there are many factors.
Monsters before ver1.0.5 had too low hp. Because of the trap of two UC cards.
Now that you've changed the unit's Gacha probability, monsters have hp to match the unit's expected damage.
[b]The monster must be pretty strong now.[/b]

[h2]4. Change the difficulty level[/h2]
Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense is a game where all the difficulty levels are open from the beginning.
Rather than challenging the level of difficulty in the middle stage, there is a psychology that makes you challenge the most difficult level, so we decided that the need for the level of difficulty in the middle is not that great.
For the quality of the difficulty design, [b]I left only 2 levels of kind difficulty and evil difficulty.[/b]
Kind difficulty is average, evil difficulty is very, very difficult, I think you can think of it as difficulty.

[h2]5. Future patch direction[/h2]
I will now introduce an item system. Items can be obtained by a monster dropping them, or by purchasing them from a store. Of course, you can get items in the Gacha way in the store.
The item will have the effect of replacing an existing unit with a completely different unit by replacing a single attack unit with a wide-area attack unit, or adding the number of attacks by the unit. It'll be worth looking forward to!

After the introduction of the item system, I will change the way the game is played for Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense.
Currently, monsters are constantly flocking, making it difficult to freely draw capsules or upgrade themten thousand
After the modification, it will definitely be a way of proceeding that separates the time into two types: maintenance time (gacha, upgrade, unit placement, etc.) and battle time (battle based on what was done during maintenance time).
I think users can enjoy Gacha and Defense better through this method.
This requires designing the way combat time progresses without losing the direction of the defense game and not too complicated. That means I need some time :(
The item system can be introduced relatively quickly, but changing the way the game is played may take time. Anyway, I'll do my best.

Thank you for reading the long post!

notes.title: Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense Update Ver1.0.44 (including hotfix)
notes.notes:
Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense Update Ver1.0.44

[h2]1. The number of attacks by some units has changed.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/097bcd647ca114c82c1fcb669d4073ea29e8cc81.gif[/img]
Now the bandits with daggers in both hands attack twice at a time.
Also, the sodmaster, who has countless swords, attacks five times each.
I worked on it because I thought it would create more fun synergy if I linked it to the item system that will come out later.

[h2]Added one-shot upgrade[/h2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/3e5f3ba3b99738b9a4eb8a96dc84f391e45fc935.gif[/img]
The existing jewel upgrade was fun, but it had the disadvantage of taking time.
When you enable the one-shot upgrade feature, the upgrade will proceed automatically until you run out of gold or when the upgrade level changes. Jewelry upgrade is expected to be very fast.
Of course, this feature is added automatically without any upgrading. :D

[h2]Other patches[/h2]
1. In the event of a failure to strengthen, the probability of a drop in the figure has been adjusted from 35% to 20%.
2. Modified the unit's attack motion mechanism.

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
1. While adding wide-area attacks, I've identified errors in some units' attacks and fixed them.

That's all. Thank you.

P.S.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/50d6fbb3479a0c928cdb1110481f13ac9c118146.gif[/img]
A zodiac upgrade will be added in ver.1.0.5.
An upgrade that can add effects to a particular class of units.
The effect could be an increase in critical hit probability, or a decrease in attack speed if you're unlucky.
You can "gacha" as much as you want, so look forward to the next update!


--------------------------------------

If you'd like to see the next update or work history, come visit my Twitter account! (no one's looking for it)

twitter : https://twitter.com/mr_mri_I

Hotfix (ver1.0.441)
[h2]1. Final boss attack error[/h2]
Recently, when modifying the attack mechanism for splash attacks, an error was found that the final boss was not hit by the attack. The error was resolved by correcting the attack mechanism again.

[h2]2. Unit upgrade error[/h2]
While patching unit specification (splash attack, change number of attacks), a bug was found that did not attack during unit upgrade, and it was resolved. I have also revised the performance system for the units that have been upgraded.
It's safe now!

[h2]3. Modify the position of the achievement clear mark[/h2]
There was an error in the achievement clear mark position in the unit's information window, and it has been resolved.

[h2]4. Changing the range of the unit[/h2]
I changed the range of the unit to differentiate the unit a little more.

notes.title: Mecha Kucha Gacha update 1.0.43.
notes.notes:
Mecha Kucha Gacha update 1.0.43

[h2]1. Fix the same gem bonus mechanism[/h2]
Now, I've modified the mechanism so that when you pick high tier units, you can get significant bonuses even if there are many low tier units.

[h2]2. Feature Upgrade[/h2]
Since the specification of the unit has been changed in the 1.0.42 update, I added the ability to upgrade critical probability and critical damage on the main screen.
Also, the Wi-Fi upgrade is now built-in, so I'll return the upgraded stars.

[h2]3. Modifying Splash Attack Mechanism[/h2]
Modified duration of splash attacks.

[h2]4. Modifying Terminology[/h2]
Existing: This unit can't give splash damage
Modified: This unit give single damage

[h2]5. Modifying the demo version[/h2]
The demo version has also been updated to match the main version.

Thank you.

notes.title: Mechakucha Gacha Update ver1.0.42
notes.notes:
[h1]Mechakucha Gacha Update ver1.0.42 Details [/h1]

[h2]1. Visualize damage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/193b5b9c1e4f378f92e1767aa4450fddae0b2da9.png[/img]
In fact, even in the Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense, a critical damage that you can't see was 'existent'!
The problem is that even if there was a critical hit damage or upgraded units, we could not know the increased damage.
Only the enemies did know.
The damage the unit gives to the enemy is now visible.
Feel the growth of the unit!

[h2]2. Unit specification readjustment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307658/6d26958075659da381acaf9d7e1aa375e147f5c7.png[/img]
In the metcha kucha gacha defense, the unit's specifications were three types: attack power, attack range, and attack speed.
Units now have different attack power, attack range, attack speed, critical hit probability, critical hit damage, wide range attack possibilities!
Originally, the higher the tier of unit, the higher the range, but now it has a range regardless of the tier of unit.
The attack range of the last boss has been re-scheduled accordingly.

In addition, the overall damage of units has increased, but the attack speed has decreased, so the importance of units capable of wide-area attacks will increase.

[h2]3. Error correction[/h2]
Modified the mechanism for enemies summoned by certain bosses.


[h2]4. Update Announcement[/h2]
First, I will add a new upgrade.
It is a function to upgrade units of a certain tier, and it is carried out in an upgrade manner that matches the Gacha game and the defense games. It's going to be fun.

I will also add an item system. Of course, there will be an item gacha accordingly, so please look forward to it!

Thank you.

notes.title: Gacha Kucha Defense Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Gacha Kucha Defense Update 1.0.4 Details

1.Unit sprite, some map graphic updates
The gap between the monster and the unit sprite has been reduced,
I modified the map that I think I couldn't implement the image in my head.

2. Increased the presence of the last boss.
Later in the game, there was a problem that the boss was covered by the attack of the units and forced the boss to hide.
Now the boss is not an introvert.

3. Modifying the convenience function
It was too senseless to have to buy the convenience function as a star.
The speed and skip functions are now built-in, and the stars will be returned to those who have already purchased them.
In addition, I have slightly lowered the cost of upgrading. Now you can spend your star on buying more jewelry and coins in-game.

The future patch direction will be for your Gacha experience. Please look forward to the next update!

from Mr.MRI
